items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: And, think it all, him and the fuller, and I am Bruce, that trombone player.

ctx.x: Billy Marrero. Billy Marrero. Billy Marrero.

Billy. I said, come get the horn. Joe's horn. Me and Billy and the partners all the time to be together. He thought I hadn't went there yet, you know. And he said, why? Get the horn. You wouldn't care if I was going to say that I'd been back. He said, well, I see him and I bought it again. All right, he bought it again. Right there. I said, well, if there's any last juice for you, get the horn, you wouldn't care if I wasn't gonna say it out, I'll clean it back. I said, well, I see him and I borrow it again. All…
I said, I ain't going to stay on here.
